Procedure

The Admission Protocol

A clear, standardized path from your initial inquiry to your scholar's first assembly.

01

Acquire the Application Dossier

Download the formal application package from this portal or collect an official hard copy from our Admissions Bureau along Acholi Road in Gulu City.

02

Assemble Academic Verification Documents

Prepare authenticated photocopies of Primary Leaving Examination (PLE) result slips for Senior One, or Uganda Certificate of Education (UCE) for Senior Five, accompanied by primary/secondary leaving certificates.

03

Submission & Document Validation

Deliver completed dossiers to our Registrar or submit certified scans via admissions@gracechristiangulu.ac.ug alongside two recent passport-format photographs and medical clearance.

04

Aptitude Assessment & Candidate Interview

Shortlisted candidates attend a morning diagnostic assessment in Mathematics and English Language, followed by an interview with the academic panel.

05

Provisional Offer & Enrollment Deposit

Admission letters are issued within seven working days. Placement is secured through payment of the UGX 150,000 admission fee through designated bank accounts.

06

Orientation & Term Commencement

Scholars report to their assigned residential halls on official opening day with prescribed uniform items and personal boarding necessities.

Verification Checklist

Mandatory Documents for Registration

Please ensure you have authenticated copies of each credential prior to submitting your formal application. Incomplete dossiers cannot be reviewed by the Academic Board.

  • ✓Original and duplicate copy of national PLE or UCE result slip
  • ✓Official primary or secondary school leaving recommendation
  • ✓Certified copy of birth certificate issued by NIRA Uganda
  • ✓Four recent identical colour passport photographs (white background)
  • ✓Medical fitness assessment signed by a registered practitioner
  • ✓National identification card copy of parent or lawful guardian

Bursaries & Academic Scholarships

Grace Christian High School maintains an endowment reserve funding up to 50% tuition reduction for candidates achieving Aggregate 4 in PLE or Grade 1 (under 12 aggregates) in UCE from financially vulnerable households in Northern Uganda.
